description: The HobbyCardIndex plans a user can buy right now: the Commercial API sizes (requests, photo scans, sold-sale lookups, cert lookups) and the app plans Pro, Dealer and Enterprise (scans a month, dealer tools, API key on Enterprise), with monthly prices in US dollars, the terms and how to buy. Pass use_case to get the size and add-ons that fit what the user wants to do. Works without an API key.

use_case.description: Optional. display_prices: show prices in their app or site. copy_all_prices: keep their own copy of every price (catalogue sync). photo_scans: identify cards from photos. sold_sales: show individual sold sales. certs_and_pop: cert lookups and population reports. own_use: price their own collection only.

name: list_plans
title: Commercial API plans and prices
